mintAuthority.summary: tGLD mints through a Tenbin-operated backend signer that holds the on-chain minter role and processes KYC-gated off-chain signed orders via the Controller; the owner multisig can grant or revoke that minter role and the dev multisig sets the supply cap and manages authorized signers.

controls.label: tGLD minter (Tenbin backend signer)

routeChecks.signingModel: Tenbin deployments identify this backend signer as minter_role; mints use KYC-gated off-chain signed orders processed through the Controller.
routeChecks.caps: Supply cap is controlled by the separate dev multisig cap_adjuster_role; signer-side hard limits were not resolved.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The custody model for the backend signing keys and any HSM/rate-limit enforcement remain unresolved.

controls.evidence: Holds minter_role on the tGLD deployment per Tenbin's deployments.json; mints execute from off-chain KYC-gated signed orders processed through the Controller (0x5e631388b24ec493619DAEEAef6fc34B33d97Dcd).

controls.label: Owner multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Owner multisig holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and can grant or revoke minter_role and other privileged roles.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The multisig implementation, threshold, signer set, modules, and guard were not independently verified.

controls.evidence: Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the tGLD deployment per deployments.json; can grant or revoke minter_role and other privileged roles. Multisig threshold and signer set not independently verified.

controls.label: Dev multisig (cap adjuster + signer manager)
controls.evidence: Holds cap_adjuster_role (can raise the supply cap) and signer_manager_role (controls which off-chain signers may authorize mints) per deployments.json. Multisig threshold and signer set not independently verified.

review.evidence: Tenbin's public deployments.json (verified contracts repo) enumerates minter_role (backend-signer EOA 0xCa2D7CfAa96290171c98e112c73fC87c2AE2fe9B plus the protocol multicall), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (owner multisig), and cap_adjuster_role / signer_manager_role (dev multisig). Minting is gated by the Controller's off-chain signed-order flow. The multisigs' threshold and signer composition were not independently verified on-chain, so confidence is manual-review. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer multisigs can raise the cap or replace signers without an evidenced independent timelock, and no whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervisor is documented.
review.reviewer: Pharos pre-launch addition; Sol economic-posture batch 2026-08-15
unresolvedQuestions: Whether the admin, owner, and dev multisigs are Gnosis Safes and their exact threshold and signer composition.
Whether the off-chain minter signing keys are HSM-bound and subject to on-chain rate limits or mint caps.
